# Fixture provenance

Parity fixtures in `images/` were produced by `tools/prepare_fixtures.py`
(downscaled to at most 640 px, re-encoded without metadata).

| Fixture | Source (Wikimedia Commons) | Author / agency | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stork_pair.jpg` | File:Wood stork pair (14197862627).jpg | U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service | Public domain (US federal government work) |
| `stork_fledglings.jpg` | File:Wood stork fledglings (14384300555).jpg | U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service | Public domain (US federal government work) |
| `cat.jpg` | File:USDA lab cat.jpg | U.S. Department of Agriculture | Public domain (US federal government work) |
| `bicycles.jpg` | File:NPS employee leading visitors on bicycles on a tour in Everglades National Park. (363cc3a5fa6745e290805799ec78f698).jpg | U.S. National Park Service | Public domain (US federal government work) |
| `sunset.jpg` | File:OCNMS -- Sunset (34736931791).jpg | NOAA Olympic Coast National Marine Sanctuary | Public domain (US federal government work) |
| `screenshot.jpg` | `gallery-site/assets/demo_light.jpg` in this repository | Urocissa project | Repository license |
| `synthetic_*.png/jpg` | Generated by `tools/prepare_fixtures.py` | — | Repository license |

`reference-*.json` files are embeddings computed by `tools/make_reference.py`
with Hugging Face transformers (FP32) from the pinned revisions in
`model.lock.json`.
